spans.s:
लू 1. लू, cl. 9. P. A. लुनाति (Ved. also
cl. 5. लुनोति), लुनीते, लुलाव (2nd sing. लु-
लविथ, 3rd du. लुलुवतुस्), लुलुवे (2nd pl. लुलु-
विध्वे or लुलुविढ्वे), लविष्यति, -ते, अलावीत्,
अलविष्ट (2nd pl. अलविध्वम् or अलविढ्वम्),
लवितुम्, to cut, sever, divide, clip, reap, pluck,
gather; to cut off, cut up, cut to pieces, destroy:
Pass. लूयते, Aor. अलावि: Caus. लावयति, -यितुम्,
Aor. अलीलवत्, अलीलवत, to cause to cut: Desid.
of Caus. लिलावयिषति: Desid. लुलूषति, -ते:
Intens. लोलूयते, लोलोति, to cut completely off: Desid.
of Intens. लोलूयिषते; [cf. Gr. λύ-ω, λύ-α, λύ-σι-ς,
λυ-τήρ, λύ-τρο-ν, ἀπο-λαύω; Lat. re-lu-o,
so-lv-o (for se-lu-o), so-lu-tu-s, lu-o, lucrum; Goth.
lau-s-j-a, laus, us-laus-ein-s, fra-lius-an; Angl.
Sax. leosan, lysan, leas, los; Lith. lauju; Slav.
ru-a-ti, runo, rus-i-ti.]

2. लू, ऊस्, ऊस्, उ, cutting, dividing, cutting off,
plucking.
